seed: Objects of type `block` under action ACTION4 with touching neighbours [arm] show mixed outcomes: no_change x10, x x4. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a global object such as a counter, HUD element or legend, read as state. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Ring (player) on the left rail; the beam (arm) starts at ring.x+5. A1/A2 move them y-/+6, carrying on-beam blocks and chain-pushing any blocks they hit. A block leaving the playfield (largest colour-4 component, flooded through objects) cancels the move.
A4/A3 change beam w by +/-6 inside the field. A hooked next/collected block (right edge = tip-1) drags the on-beam blocks; otherwise extending pushes swept blocks. If the group cannot move, only the beam changes. The block A4 mixed outcome is this push/hook geometry, not a counter or legend.
Clicks are full no-ops. The HUD bar (row of 2/3) turns its rightmost 2 into 3 on every 3rd non-click action (n>=4, (n-1)%3==0). The counter is hidden and continuity-gated; fallback n=3*#3s+1, or 0 if there are no 3s. Stateless replay passes 32/45.
